This tutorial introduces to custom models with the package `housepi`.
To create a custom model, we recommend not starting from scratch, but instead to copy a template model and modify all its relevant parts.

## Template Models

To copy a template to a custom path we use the function `household_model_template`:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# copy the heterogeneous chain binomial template to a custom directory
my_model_path <- "custom_folder"
housepi::household_model_template(which = "chain_binom_heter", 
                                  path = my_model_path)
```

Modify all relevant parts of the C++ implementation *model.cpp* and of the header *model.h* within your model directory.
*Note:* to avoid errors we recommend changing only the chunks of code indicated with "CHANGE-ME".

We generate according to the custom directory.
All other commands remain the same.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
hemi <- housepi::generate_model(my_model_path)
```
